text: My daily routine is simple but well organized. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my day with a healthy breakfast. After that, I get ready and begin work at nine. I work until five in the afternoon, with a short lunch break in between. Later, I go to the gym or take a walk in the park to stay active. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a little TV, and read before bed. I try to keep the same schedule every day because consistency helps me feel calm, healthy, and ready for the next morning.
